I couldn't find a time for the Gannet call, so I didn't give Tobias one. I replied in his DM to say so.

**What I checked:** The calendar had nothing for November. "Gannet" didn't come up in his DM, the channels he's in (#central-team, #central-random, #general, #help-it-ops, #inc-tansley-carrier-api), the shared files or the mailbox. The calendar and mailbox tools only cover "this member", and I'm not certain that's Tobias rather than me. In the reply I called them "your calendar" and "your mail", so that part may be slightly off.

I didn't use `search_messages`, because its results include conversations Tobias can't see.

**What I asked him:** Who is organising the call. Once he has an invite or a posted time, I offered to check it against the rest of his week or put a hold on his calendar.
